## NODE char_peter Character "Saint Peter" "Butler's Lives of the Saints" "June 29"
summary: Apostle and first Pope; originally a fisherman named Simon, renamed Peter (the Rock) by Christ; crucified upside down in Rome.

## NODE char_paul Character "Saint Paul" "Butler's Lives of the Saints" "June 29"
summary: Apostle to the Gentiles; originally Saul of Tarsus, a persecutor of Christians who converted on the road to Damascus; martyred in Rome.

## NODE char_francis Character "Saint Francis of Assisi" "Butler's Lives of the Saints" "October 4"
summary: Founder of the Franciscan Order; son of a wealthy merchant who embraced poverty; known for preaching to animals and the Canticle of the Sun.

## NODE char_thomas_aquinas Character "Saint Thomas Aquinas" "Butler's Lives of the Saints" "January 28"
summary: Dominican friar and theologian; author of the Summa Theologica; the leading scholastic philosopher of the Catholic Church.

## NODE char_mary Character "Virgin Mary" "Golden Legend" "Assumption"
summary: Mother of Jesus; venerated as the Theotokos (God-bearer); assumed body and soul into heaven.

## NODE char_patrick Character "Saint Patrick" "Butler's Lives of the Saints" "March 17"
summary: Apostle of Ireland; enslaved as a youth, he returned to convert the Irish; associated with the shamrock and the expulsion of snakes.

## NODE place_rome Place "Rome" "Butler's Lives of the Saints" "June 29"
summary: The Eternal City; site of the martyrdoms of Peter and Paul; center of the Catholic Church.

## NODE place_assisi Place "Assisi" "Butler's Lives of the Saints" "October 4"
summary: Italian town in Umbria; birthplace of Saint Francis and Saint Clare.

## NODE place_damascus Place "Damascus" "Acts of the Apostles" "chapter 9"
summary: City where Saul of Tarsus experienced his blinding conversion on the road; renamed Paul.

## NODE place_irish_sea Place "The Irish Sea" "Butler's Lives of the Saints" "March 17"
summary: Waters crossed by Saint Patrick on his mission to Ireland.

## NODE event_martyrdom_peter Event "Martyrdom of Saint Peter" "Butler's Lives of the Saints" "June 29"
summary: The crucifixion of Peter in Rome under Emperor Nero; he asked to be crucified upside down, deeming himself unworthy to die as Christ did.

## NODE event_conversion_paul Event "Conversion of Saint Paul" "Acts of the Apostles" "chapter 9"
summary: Saul's blinding vision of the risen Christ on the road to Damascus, transforming him from persecutor to apostle.

## NODE event_council_nicaea Event "Council of Nicaea" "Golden Legend" "325 AD"
summary: The first ecumenical council (325 AD) that affirmed the divinity of Christ and produced the Nicene Creed.

## NODE obj_keys Object "Keys of Heaven" "Golden Legend" "Matthew 16:19"
summary: The keys given to Peter by Christ, symbolizing his authority to bind and loose; a symbol of the papacy.

## NODE concept_canonization Concept "Canonization" "Golden Legend" "process"
summary: The process by which the Catholic Church declares a person a saint, recognizing their heroic virtue and intercessory power.

## EDGE edge_peter_martyrdom char_peter ASSOCIATED_WITH event_martyrdom_peter "Butler's Lives of the Saints" "June 29"
## EDGE edge_peter_martyrdom_place event_martyrdom_peter TOOK_PLACE_AT place_rome "Butler's Lives of the Saints" "June 29"
## EDGE edge_peter_keys char_peter ASSOCIATED_WITH obj_keys "Golden Legend" "Matthew 16:19"
## EDGE edge_peter_ruler char_peter RULER_OF place_rome "Golden Legend" "papacy"
## EDGE edge_paul_conversion char_paul ASSOCIATED_WITH event_conversion_paul "Acts of the Apostles" "chapter 9"
## EDGE edge_conversion_place event_conversion_paul TOOK_PLACE_AT place_damascus "Acts of the Apostles" "chapter 9"
## EDGE edge_paul_met_peter char_paul MET char_peter "Acts of the Apostles" "chapter 15"

## EDGE edge_francis_worshipped char_francis WORSHIPPED_AS char_mary "Golden Legend" "Canticle of the Sun"

## EDGE edge_peter_fought char_peter FOUGHT char_paul "Acts of the Apostles" "Galatians 2"
